create_SignalReport: create a SignalReport instance to compare predicted vs measured observation data with Plotly
build_SignalReport_figure: build a Plotly figure from time series data comparing predicted and measured signals
resample_SignalReport_data: resample time series data to a target frequency or maximum number of datapoints for plotting
get_SignalReport_context: get the rendering context dictionary with plot HTML for embedding a signal comparison report
review_SignalReport_header_includes: review the header_includes method that returns the Plotly JavaScript library tag for HTML embedding
